newsitem.title: USA: Plexus to redeem Series A preferred.
newsitem.headline: Plexus to redeem Series A preferred.

text.p: Plexus Corp, a contract provider of design, manufacturing and testing services to the electronics industry, said it will redeem all outstanding shares of its Series A preferred stock on February 28, 1997.
It will pay holders the per-share face value of $1,000 plus all accrued and unpaid dividends, for $1,012 per preferred share, or a total of about $7.1 million.

Holders have the option to convert the prefered shares into 79.2079 shares of Plexus common for each preferred stock share. Assuming full conversion of the outstanding preferred, the company would issue 554,455 shares of its common stock.
